annotations.title: Check a trade against the rating and its record

description: Checks one U.S.-listed stock or ETF at the moment of a trade: returns the full Market Eyes Live MELANY rating (the same fields as get_stock_rating) together with what the public graded record says about calls carrying that tier: the share of such calls that beat more than half of the other core stocks rated the same day, over the following week and month, with the number of calls behind each figure and the 50% no skill line (a REIT is looked up under the app's own REIT label; an ETF gets no tier figure, because funds are not graded against the same day list, and the record says so). Use this when an agent is about to propose a buy or a sell, for example 'check NVDA before I buy' or 'what does Market Eyes Live say about selling AAPL', so the person approving the trade sees the rating, its tone and its record side by side. The side (buy or sell) only shapes the wording; the rating and the record are the same either way. Do not use for quotes, order placement, options, crypto, futures, non-U.S. listings, or a personal recommendation. Limitations: the daily-refreshed set answers instantly, other covered tickers are scored live at a lower hourly limit; the record is read from the public feed at https://marketeyeslive.com/api/validation-status and is left out, with a note, when that feed cannot be read in time; it does not return any trade plan values. Method: https://marketeyeslive.com/how-melany-is-tested.html. Research data, not financial advice; this tool is read-only and never places trades.

side.description: optional: the trade being considered; it changes the wording only

symbol.description: U.S. ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, AAPL, VOO

name: check_trade

outputSchema.description: The rating (every get_stock_rating field) plus read and record. Omitted for not-covered, not-found or rate-limited results, which return an explanatory text message instead.

asset_class.description: stock, etf or reit: which label table the eight factor slots carry (a fund's quality slot is cost and structure, a REIT's valuation slot is price against funds from operations)

freshness.description: present only when scored live on demand

methodology.description: how the ratings are built and graded

rating_page.description: the public rating page for this ticker

rating_tier.description: Conviction tier. Mature ladder, weakest to strongest: Unfavorable, Hold, Favorable, Highest Conviction. Favorable and Highest Conviction are both favorable reads; Highest Conviction is a composite of 69 or above (for a stock, a small hysteresis can hold a borderline label steady between refreshes; a fund or REIT word follows its label in the app, which has none). Names the mature ladder does not cover carry their own label: Promising, then Very Promising, then Rising Star for names without mature fundamentals, Runner! for a momentum surge, Catalyst Watch for a news-driven gap up on volume. ETFs and REITs use the same mature ladder, chosen by the tone of the fund's own label in the app (a favorable fund label reads Favorable or Highest Conviction, a cautious or neutral one Hold, a negative one Unfavorable); a leveraged or inverse fund never reads above Hold. These nine words are the complete set; null when no tier applies.

read.description: the rating in one sentence and its tone

tone.description: positive, neutral, negative, speculative, flag, or none when the name carries none of the nine published tier words

record.description: What the public graded record says about calls carrying this tier: the share that beat more than half of the other core stocks rated the same day, over each window. 50% is the no skill line. Present on every success; available is false when the feed could not be read in time.

beat_same_day_list.description: 0 to 1: share of calls that beat more than half of the same day list

beat_sector_peers.description: 0 to 1: the same against same day core stocks in the same industry

note.description: the record in one plain sentence

tier_recorded_as.description: the record groups Favorable and Highest Conviction as one favorable tier

trade_plan.description: Present only when Market Eyes Live has a trade plan for this ticker (including a suggested entry zone and a model position size; the same plan for every reader, not based on anyone's account, holdings or finances). The plan values are never included here; they are part of a Market Eyes Live subscription.

described_on.description: the rating page, present when that page describes the plan

included.description: always false: the plan values are not part of this data

title: Check a trade against the rating and its record
